examples.explanation: 'l', 'o' and 'e' repeat; the first singleton is 'v' at index 2.
Both letters appear twice, so there is no singleton.

hints: Count how many times each of the 26 letters occurs in one pass.
Make a second left-to-right pass and stop at the first letter whose count is 1.
Two linear passes beat checking every pair of positions.
title: 463. First Unique Character in a String
